## Preferred Short Description

Nexor / Plattnericus is a fullstack developer from South Tyrol building real-world web apps, interactive browser experiences, selfhosted systems, DevOps workflows and security-focused infrastructure.

## Preferred Long Description

Nexor / Plattnericus works across frontend, backend, infrastructure and deployment. The public project portfolio includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, JavaScript, Docker, Linux and Cloudflare-based workflows. The direction is fullstack engineering with a strong focus on DevOps and a growing cybersecurity skill set.
